actions.name: Use
actions.area: creatures within a 30-ft.-radius centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates a ghost and curses creatures around them
description.value: The caster emulates a ghost and curses creatures around them. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Will save or be inflicted with Cursed status effect. Learned From Gheist and Ghost Family Cursed: This status effect prohibits the creature from using Supernatural (Su) class features and abilities.
